SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MEMBER_NO AS "memberNo", EMAIL AS "memberEmail", NICKNAME AS "memberNickname", NAME AS "memberName", PROFILE_IMAGE AS "memberProfileImg", MEMBER_TYPE AS "memberRole", STATUS AS "memberStatus", TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt" FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE 1=1
AND NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%'
AND (NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_BOARD C
JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO
WHERE C.STATUS != 'N'
AND (C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_REVIEW R
JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO
WHERE R.STATUS != 'N'
AND (R.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOMMODATION WHERE 1=1

INSERT INTO ACCOMMODATION ( ACCOMMODATION_NO, NAME, ADDRESS, PHONE, ACCOMMODATION_TYPE, REGION, PRICE_MIN, PRICE_MAX, CHECK_IN_TIME, CHECK_OUT_TIME, FACILITIES, THUMBNAIL_URL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, RECOMMENDATION_REASON, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ACCOM_NO.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{accommodationType}, #{region}, #{priceMin}, #{priceMax}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{facilities}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{recommendationReason}, 'A', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE ACCOMMODATION SET NAME = #{name}, ADDRESS = #{address}, PHONE = #{phone}, ACCOMMODATION_TYPE = #{accommodationType}, REGION = #{region}, PRICE_MIN = #{priceMin}, PRICE_MAX = #{priceMax}, CHECK_IN_TIME = #{checkInTime}, CHECK_OUT_TIME = #{checkOutTime}, FACILITIES = #{facilities}, THUMBNAIL_URL = #{thumbnailUrl}, LATITUDE = #{latitude}, LONGITUDE = #{longitude}, RECOMMENDATION_REASON = #{recommendationReason}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ACCOMMODATION_NO = #{accommodationNo}
mapper.select: SELECT R.REPORT_NO AS "reportNo", R.TARGET_TYPE AS "targetType", R.TARGET_NO AS "targetNo", R.MEMBER_NO AS "memberNo", R.REPORT_TYPE AS "reportType", R.DETAIL_REASON AS "detailReason", R.STATUS AS "status", R.RESULT AS "result", TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", TO_CHAR(R.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt", M.NICKNAME AS "reporterNickname", /* 신고 대상 제목 — COMMENT인 경우 댓글 본문 앞 50자 표시 */ CASE R.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'FREEBOARD' THEN (SELECT B.TITLE FROM BOARD B WHERE B.BOARD_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'COMPANION' THEN (SELECT CB.TITLE FROM COMPANION_BOARD CB WHERE CB.COMPANION_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN (SELECT CR.TITLE FROM COMPANION_REVIEW CR WHERE CR.REVIEW_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(C.CONTENT, 50, 1) FROM COMMENT_TBL C WHERE C.COMMENT_NO = R.TARGET_NO) END AS "targetTitle", /* 신고 대상 작성자 닉네임 — COMMENT인 경우 댓글 작성자 조회 */ CASE R.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'FREEBOARD' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M2 ON B.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'COMPANION' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM COMPANION_BOARD CB JOIN MEMBER M2 ON CB.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE CB.COMPANION_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM COMPANION_REVIEW CR JOIN MEMBER M2 ON CR.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE CR.REVIEW_NO = R.TARGET_NO) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN (SELECT M2.NICKNAME FROM COMMENT_TBL C JOIN MEMBER M2 ON C.MEMBER_NO = M2.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.COMMENT_NO = R.TARGET_NO) END AS "targetAuthorNickname" FROM CONTENT_REPORT R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, RESULT = #{result}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
